description: This file defines a mock class 'IpcClientMock' for the 'IIpcClient' interface, used for unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It includes mock methods for obtaining a channel, creating a blocking closure, and creating an RPC controller, and references external classes and libraries such as Google Mock.
